title: Act: Emit objectHover and build the anchored ObjectOverlay in App
summary: Emit objectHover from BootScene and render ObjectOverlay with plate and action buttons driven by content.
description: BootScene emits objectHover on SceneObject hover; new ObjectOverlay component uses anchorFor and game.view; App renders it in place of ActionMenu and passes onLayout.
acceptance_criteria: objectHover emits {id} on hover over and {id:null} on out
ObjectOverlay shows upper-case name and action buttons for the hovered or focused object

in_scope: hand cursor for bounded objects in renderContext

definition_of_done: Overlay visible for hover and focus

steps.action: Add method onHoverChange(cb:(e:{objectId:string;over:boolean})=>void) storing a private hoverListener; in the constructor handle.onHover callback (L33-L37) call this.hoverListener?.({objectId:this.spec.id, over}) after the highlight calls.
After the onInteract line add sceneObjects.forEach to call o.onHoverChange(e => phaserToReact.emit('objectHover',{id: e.over ? e.objectId : null})).
steps.code: this.sceneObjects.forEach((o) => o.onHoverChange((e) => phaserToReact.emit('objectHover', { id: e.over ? e.objectId : null })));

steps.action: Change the bounded branch to call image.setInteractive(new Phaser.Geom.Rectangle(x,y,width,height), Phaser.Geom.Rectangle.Contains) then image.input.cursor = 'pointer' guarded by image.input being defined, so the hand cursor is used for bounded objects too.

Create component ObjectOverlay({view, objectsSpec, layout, activeId, onAction}). Find the object in view by activeId, find its ObjectSpec (position, scale, interactionBounds) from scene.objects in runtime/content, compute anchorFor with layout, and render an absolutely positioned Frame kind='plaque' showing name.toUpperCase() above top point and a Frame with one Button per action (label upper-cased) beneath bottom point. Return null when no active object, no anchor or no layout. Button onClick calls onAction(object.id, action.id).

Remove ActionMenu import and render. Add state hoverId (set from phaserToReact.on('objectHover')) and layout (set from PhaserHost onLayout). Compute activeId = hoverId ?? focusedObjectId from useGameStore, keep selectedId set by objectClick. Render <ObjectOverlay .../> inside the scene slot and pass onLayout to PhaserHost.
